spec: Implement the user-supplied requirements at https://github.com/contoso/ledger-service/issues/65. Source revision: 2026-10-13T09:00:00Z. Task acceptance criteria below map that scope to specialist-owned work.

tasks.title: Use a PostgreSQL driver that does not pin
tasks.body:
Upgrade the PostgreSQL JDBC driver, within its current major version, to a release that guards its I/O with locks instead of `synchronized`.

## Acceptance criteria
- `JdbcLedgerRepositoryIT` passes.
- The upgrade is its own PR with no other library change.

tasks.title: Cap open database connections
tasks.body:
Add `BoundedDataSource` to `ledger-persistence`, which limits open connections to 32, and use it where `ledger-app` builds its `DataSource`.

## Acceptance criteria
- A test shows that `getConnection()` beyond the limit waits until a connection closes.
- A failed `getConnection()` releases its permit.

tasks.title: Serve HTTP on virtual threads
tasks.body:
Replace the fixed thread pool in `LedgerApplication` with `Executors.newVirtualThreadPerTaskExecutor()`.

## Acceptance criteria
- All tests pass and `/journals` and `/accounts/{account}/balance` respond unchanged.
- The PR description tells payments which image tag to test.

tasks.title: Show pinned virtual threads in CI
tasks.body:
Run the integration tests in `.github/workflows/ci.yml` with `-Djdk.tracePinnedThreads=short` and fail the job when a pinned thread is reported.

## Acceptance criteria
- A deliberately pinned test thread fails the job.
- The current code passes.
